angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 911,367 km at 199.73 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.0067 +/- 0.0128 mas (same row, RUWE 0.99): 199.73 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.31 +/- 0.08 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-101 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 911,367 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.41 +/- 0.3 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-101 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6380 +/- 120 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-101 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-101 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-101.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.353, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-101 (pscomppars): spectral type F6, from Hellier et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014MNRAS.440.1982H/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, CPD-23 1329: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-101 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.2 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-101 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.42052, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-101 (pscomppars): age 1.14 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-101 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 12.4 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
